title: feat(nsfz): z-probe formdraw PVM reverse/face some; n(Cz) != n(Dz)
science: Formdraw kernel on the z-probes: n(A_z)=(0,0,-1/3), n(B)=(-1/3,0,-1/3), n(C_z)=(0,-1/3,-1/3), n(D_z)=(0,0,-1/3), so n(C_z) != n(D_z) where the x-probes have n(C)=n(D); both letters legal -> 16 combos -> some/some. Decisively, the runner evaluates two RIVAL selectors on the identical state in the same run: unique P_+ gives reverse 0 hits, and ndot along e_3 gives all letters `-` and reverse 0 hits.
